prompt.content:
Shorten to at most 50 words for an SMS alert. The case number CS-88120 and the deadline must survive verbatim; the consequence must not be softened.

"Our records show the supporting documents for case CS-88120 have not been received. If they are not uploaded by 5:00 PM on Friday, September 18, the case will be closed and a new application, including a new filing fee, will be required. Upload at the portal using your existing login."

scoring.rubric: Criteria: (1) at most 50 words; (2) CS-88120 verbatim and the 5:00 PM Friday, September 18 deadline intact; (3) closure + new-application-with-new-fee consequence stated, not softened; (4) nothing invented. General scale: 10 = fully follows the instruction, preserves all factual content, flawless grammar; 7-9 = follows instruction with minor lapses (one small omitted nuance or slightly off tone); 4-6 = partially follows instruction or introduces a factual distortion; 1-3 = largely ignores instruction or loses key meaning; 0 = unrelated output.

prompt.content:

"The recall covers lot codes L-771 through L-779, sold between May and July. Affected chargers can overheat during the first hour of charging.
